nom: Bali Body Hydrating Natural Watermelon Tanning Oil SPF15

segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin reports the oil is very moisturizing and keeps skin hydrated all day and even the next day.
segments.sensitive: Two reviewers with sensitive skin report no rash, irritation, or burning after use, calling it sensitive-skin friendly, though other tanning products from other brands had triggered reactions for one of them.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say the oil left skin soft, moisturized, and hydrated for the day and into the next day; no dissent reported.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several who say they normally burn easily, report no burning or redness even with extended sun exposure; one reviewer with fair skin says she burned slightly more than expected with another SPF15 product, and one reports skin was left with prickly-heat-free, non-peeling results.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her whole body broke out in spots days after use, worsening even after repeated use of a tan remover; this is an isolated report among otherwise positive experiences.
concerns.oiliness: Opinions split: several reviewers say it is not greasy or oily and sinks in well, while others describe it as very oily, slow to absorb, sitting on the skin for over 20 minutes, or leaving marks on clothing/bikinis.

aspects.libelle: Bottle size too small for price
No burning even for fair, burn-prone skin

extraits.texte: It didn't really work for me, I have quite fair skin and struggle to tan so thought I'd give this a go, it was extremely oily and felt I couldn't go for a swim or sit down anywhere, didn't really sink into the skin like I'd hoped it would. That being said i didn't get a burn either which i usually do burn quite easily with SPF15.

When I tell you I have never tanned naturally in my life, I promise you that. I was committed to having tanned skin that I have literally been applying fake tan since I was 16 every 3 nights lol!! It's very annoying, and I've always been super insecure about it. Happy to report!!! This 100% works! Having very fair skin, I used it and only layed in the sun for about 10-15 minutes for the first week. And already I had colour to me not that awful white almost purple looking skin. Keeping in my mind my normal process is burn, peel, gain some freckles and stay white lol. So this was HUGE. I also showered and mousturised straight after, not sure if this helps but I feel like it did! The before and after picture is not a lie and I'm so happy about it! A week and a half!!! For about 10-15 minutes each side for about 5 days!!! What the heck!! I'm just so happy I found this, now I feel like I can actually enjoy myself this summer instead of not going in water and doing fun things because of a fake tan lol! If you're unsure, I promise you!! I am so happy with my decision right now 🙏🏼🥰🫶🏼🫶🏼

I took this oil with me to France a few weeks ago and I have purchased it as far back as 3 years ago when I went home to South Africa! Both times I was absolutely inlove. This oil is the best feeling oil I've ever used on my skin ( light weight ) and its smell is so fresh and lovely; it's also not overpowering at all. The oil is great if you have dry skin too, keeps me moisturised all day and even the next day after use 💞

I did everything as it was described, exfoliated first, rubbed my body with body lotion (especially on the dry spots) and the day after I used the self-tanner. Left it on for 1 hour and the result was pretty good at first! The result a few days (almost a week now) later is SICK --> see picture! My whole body is full of spots. I look ridiculous. Since I did not want to have situations like this I also bought the "Self Tan Remover", I have used it 7 times now and even let it soak in. NOTHING works, it only gets worse! The product is really not quality. No quality while you pay a lot.

I've tried other tanning products from other brands and ended up in triggering serious rash all over the body. This product from Bali Body claims to be sensitive skin friendly which after multiple uses, I can say it worked really well with my tan and haven't caused any skin problems. Highly recommended for those with sensitive skin!

Got this for FREE with my tanning milk and omg it's the best ever I have such sensitive skin and don't usually tan well and I'm just back from 8 days in Croatia and I have the nicest tan ever and didn't get burnt so delighted will be repurchasing!!
No burning skin . This has to be the best sun screen I've ever used. I'm. Not a sun bather mostly under the umbrella. I've not had any peeling skin or prickly heat . My skin was so hydrated
